notes: Extent approximate (lon 89.80-90.80, lat 26.74-27.14), NOT the official GMC boundary. Elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 (a surface model, so forest canopy is included). Land cover: ESA WorldCover 2021. Vertical exaggeration 1.5x; y=0 is sea level x1.5. Corner radius 3 km. Skirt depth 2,533 m. GLB skirt is plain umber-earth: strata live in the Blender file / kit createSkirt(). AO not baked yet; LOD1 not made yet. M2 rivers: traced from the DEM (60 m priority-flood + D8; min catchment 4 km², 12 km² on the plain), widths 30-260 m from catchment and WorldCover water; terrain carved ~2.5 m (real) below the water. Gravel beds are still painted into the terrain albedo, not a separate mesh.
